case_title: Misleading Advertisement and Defective Water Purifier

additional_evidence_concerns.reason: The advertisement screenshot is available, but its authenticity and context require verification.
No independent water quality test report has been provided.
The installation record is available, but its details require examination.

expected_defects.description: The claimant assumes that the advertisement automatically establishes fraud and legal liability.
The independent water quality test report is missing.
The 99.9% purification claim requires examination of its testing conditions and supporting evidence.
The cause of the unusual taste and smell has not been established.

expected_review.reason: The standard complaint documents are present, but the water quality evidence and advertisement claim require further examination.

expected_outcome.recommended_action: Obtain an independent water quality test report and verify the advertisement's performance claims.

testing_notes: All four standard checklist documents should be marked Present.
The missing water quality report must be identified as additional evidence.
The system must distinguish misleading advertisement allegations from established facts.
The system must not automatically conclude that fraud or liability is established.
